Health/TenantHealthCheck.cs.reason: Health check with mockeable service dependencies

justifications.unit: Unit tests cover the default and configured registrations, custom stores, and the multi-tenancy marker that the dead letter manager and the ABAC decision audit reader share.

TenancyErrors.cs.reason: Error factory with stable codes and categories

justifications.unit: Unit tests call both factories and assert each code, its ErrorCategory and that the message carries no tenant id.
justifications.guard: Both factories are parameterless static methods with no guard clause, so guard tests have nothing to reject here.
